in_marathi.name: Brijraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Joyful Pasture
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brijraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brijraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Brija’ (joyful pasture) and ‘Raja’ (king). This name signifies the one who rules over the joyful pasture, often associated with Lord Krishna. In Hindu mythology, Krishna is known as the god of love, compassion, and joy.
